entries.en: Afshar lowered the blinds so we could see the projected photographs.
entries.zh: 阿夫沙尔放下百叶窗，好让我们看清投影的照片。

entries.en: Aftab offered me the only dry chair on the balcony.
entries.zh: 阿夫塔卜把阳台上唯一一把干椅子让给了我。

entries.en: We skipped the after-party because our last train left before midnight.
entries.zh: 我们没去余兴派对，因为末班火车午夜前就开走了。

entries.en: The drummer softened the afterbeat so the singer's entrance would stand out.
entries.zh: 鼓手减轻了拍后音，好让歌手的进入更突出。

entries.en: The surveyor found deep scratches along the ship's afterbody.
entries.zh: 验船师在船体后部发现了几道深划痕。

entries.en: The engineers compared fuel consumption with and without afterburning during the engine trials.
entries.zh: 在发动机试验中，工程师们比较了有后燃和无后燃时的燃料消耗。

entries.en: The unexpected repair bill was an afterclap to our supposedly settled dispute.
entries.zh: 那张意外的维修账单，使我们本以为已经解决的纠纷又生了枝节。

entries.en: The replacement aftercooler would not fit through the workshop door.
entries.zh: 替换用的后冷却器无法从车间门口搬进去。

entries.en: The sheep grazed on the aftergrass where we had cut hay in June.
entries.zh: 羊群在我们六月割过干草的地方吃着再生草。

entries.en: Dense aftergrowth hid the path we had cleared the previous spring.
entries.zh: 茂密的再生植物遮住了我们前一年春天清理出的小路。

entries.en: The afterguard remained on deck while the other sailors went below.
entries.zh: 其他水手下舱时，船尾值勤的海员仍留在甲板上。

entries.meaningZh: 最后挤出的牛奶〔古语或方言，复数〕
entries.en: The dairymaid poured the afterings into a small pail beside the stool.
entries.zh: 女挤奶工把最后挤出的牛奶倒进凳子旁的一只小桶里。

entries.en: In the afterlight, the roofs still glowed above the darkening streets.
entries.zh: 余辉中，屋顶在渐暗的街道上方仍泛着光。

entries.en: The two fictional rulers imagined very different afterlives for themselves.
entries.zh: 那两位虚构的统治者为自己想象了截然不同的来世。

entries.en: He bought an afternooner at the station and read it on the train.
entries.zh: 他在车站买了一份下午报，在火车上读了起来。

entries.en: The mechanic retrieved the missing toolbox from the afterpeak.
entries.zh: 机械师从尾尖舱里找回了失踪的工具箱。

entries.en: She planted the orchard for an aftertime she knew she might never see.
entries.zh: 她栽下那片果园，是为了一个她明知自己可能永远看不到的未来。

entries.en: Maya used aftertouch to add vibrato to the sustained keyboard note.
entries.zh: 玛雅利用键后触感给持续的键盘音符加上了颤音。

entries.en: The fabric needed further aftertreatment before the workshop could accept the order as finished.
entries.zh: 那批织物还需要再处理，车间才能认定订单已经完成。

entries.en: His afterwit did nothing to recover the tickets we had thrown away.
entries.zh: 他的事后聪明并没能帮我们找回已经扔掉的票。

entries.en: In afteryears, she remembered the noisy kitchen more clearly than the grand ceremony.
entries.zh: 在以后的岁月里，相比那场盛大仪式，她对喧闹厨房的记忆反而更清晰。

entries.en: Afton held the ladder while I repaired the loose gutter.
entries.zh: 我修理松动的雨水槽时，阿夫顿扶着梯子。

entries.en: Afzal brought an extra towel after noticing the puddle by the bath.
entries.zh: 阿夫扎尔注意到浴缸旁的积水后，又拿来了一条毛巾。

entries.en: Agah chose a seat near the door to avoid disturbing the others later.
entries.zh: 阿加选了一个靠门的座位，以免稍后打扰别人。

entries.en: The carver saved the smallest pieces of agalloch for a future project.
entries.zh: 雕刻师把最小的沉香木碎料留了下来，打算以后做别的作品用。

entries.en: Agamben left a pair of gardening gloves on the kitchen windowsill.
entries.zh: 阿甘本把一副园艺手套留在了厨房窗台上。

entries.en: The botanist treated the two forms as a single agamospecies.
entries.zh: 那位植物学家把这两种形态归作同一个无性种。

entries.en: Agamy in the fictional colony complicated disputes over inheritance.
entries.zh: 虚构殖民地中的无婚姻制使继承纠纷变得更复杂。

entries.en: Agan wrapped the cracked bowl in newspaper before putting it away.
entries.zh: 阿甘把有裂缝的碗用报纸包好，才收了起来。

entries.en: Agapov climbed back upstairs when he realised he had forgotten his umbrella.
entries.zh: 阿加波夫意识到忘带雨伞后，又爬上了楼。

entries.en: Agarwal asked whether the empty shelf could hold the heavier books.
entries.zh: 阿加瓦尔问那层空书架能不能放更重的书。

entries.en: Agata folded the picnic blanket before the grass became damp.
entries.zh: 草地变潮之前，阿加塔把野餐毯收叠好了。

entries.en: Agathe let the soup cool while she searched for clean spoons.
entries.zh: 阿加特一边让汤晾凉，一边找干净的勺子。

entries.en: Agathon promised to return the borrowed suitcase by Thursday.
entries.zh: 阿加顿答应星期四之前归还借来的行李箱。

entries.en: He lifted the hem of his agbada before climbing the narrow stairs.
entries.zh: 上那段狭窄的楼梯前，他提起了男式长袍的下摆。

entries.en: Agbayani moved the flowers away from the open window.
entries.zh: 阿格瓦亚尼把花从开着的窗边移开了。

entries.en: The survey excluded people outside the eighteen-to-twenty-five age-bracket.
entries.zh: 这项调查不包括十八至二十五岁这个年龄范围以外的人。

entries.en: My grandfather found an age-mate who shared his enthusiasm for chess.
entries.zh: 我祖父找到了一位同样热衷于国际象棋的同龄人。

entries.en: Agel bought a smaller bag so it would fit inside the locker.
entries.zh: 阿格尔买了一个小一些的包，好放进储物柜。

entries.en: The chair reserved the first ten minutes for agenda-setting rather than debate.
entries.zh: 主席把最初十分钟留给议程设置，而不是辩论。

entries.en: Agenor carried the sleepy puppy home inside his coat.
entries.zh: 阿热诺尔把困倦的小狗裹在外套里抱回了家。

entries.en: The agent-general asked for a quieter room before the meeting began.
entries.zh: 会议开始前，那位州驻外代表要求换一间更安静的房间。

entries.en: Our fictional courier delivered the envelope to Agere before returning to the depot.
entries.zh: 我们故事中的快递员把信封送到杰尔系统公司后，返回了配送站。

entries.en: Agero spotted a dropped wallet beneath the last row of seats.
entries.zh: 阿赫罗在最后一排座椅下面发现了一个遗落的钱包。

entries.en: Ageyev offered the window seat to the child carrying a camera.
entries.zh: 阿格耶夫把靠窗的座位让给了那个拿着相机的孩子。

entries.en: Aggarwal taped the torn map together before we set off.
entries.zh: 出发前，阿加沃尔用胶带把撕破的地图粘好了。

entries.en: Two bright aggies rolled out of the old wooden toy chest.
entries.zh: 两颗亮闪闪的玛瑙弹球从那个旧木玩具箱里滚了出来。

entries.en: The mixture crumbled when the agglomerant was left out.
entries.zh: 漏加粘结剂后，那份混合物碎散了。

entries.en: We compared the agglutinability of the cells under identical conditions.
entries.zh: 我们在相同条件下比较了这些细胞的可凝集性。

entries.en: Aggradation gradually raised the riverbed beside the old bridge.
entries.zh: 沉积逐渐抬高了老桥旁的河床。

entries.en: Her agileness allowed her to catch the falling glass before it hit the floor.
entries.zh: 她身手敏捷，在玻璃杯落地前接住了它。

entries.meaningZh: 安捷伦科技公司〔公司名〕
entries.en: The driver waited outside Agilent while the parcel was signed for.
entries.zh: 包裹签收时，司机在安捷伦科技公司外等候。

entries.en: Even the committee's stubborn aginner supported replacing the broken heating system.
entries.zh: 就连委员会里那个顽固反对变革的人，也支持更换坏掉的供暖系统。

entries.en: Agins found enough wrapping paper for both birthday presents.
entries.zh: 阿金斯找到了足够包装两份生日礼物的包装纸。

entries.meaningZh: 意大利石油总公司〔公司名〕
entries.en: In the story, Nora leaves her bicycle outside Agip's office.
entries.zh: 故事中，诺拉把自行车停在意大利石油总公司的办公室外。

entries.en: Agis saved the last slice of cake for a friend arriving late.
entries.zh: 阿吉斯把最后一块蛋糕留给了一位要晚到的朋友。

entries.en: During the drought, the neighbours offered agistment for our cattle.
entries.zh: 旱灾期间，邻居们提出帮我们代养牛群。

entries.en: Agius noticed that the washing machine had stopped halfway through its cycle.
entries.zh: 阿吉厄斯注意到洗衣机洗到一半就停了。

entries.en: Agler replaced the missing cupboard handle with a loop of rope.
entries.zh: 阿格勒尔用一个绳环替代了丢失的橱柜把手。

entries.en: Aglio volunteered to fetch more plates from the downstairs cupboard.
entries.zh: 阿利奥主动提出去楼下的橱柜里多拿些盘子。

entries.en: Aglionby brought the wet cushions indoors before the rain grew heavier.
entries.zh: 雨势变大之前，阿格利昂比把湿坐垫搬进了屋。

entries.meaningZh: 海豹在冰上凿出的呼吸孔〔加拿大英语〕
entries.en: The photographer waited at a distance from the aglu without disturbing the ice.
entries.zh: 摄影师在离海豹呼吸孔一段距离的地方等候，没有扰动冰面。

entries.en: The chemist separated the aglycon from the sugar component.
entries.zh: 化学家把糖苷配基与糖组分分离了。

entries.en: Agne stayed behind to collect the costumes after the final performance.
entries.zh: 最后一场演出结束后，阿格尼留下来收拾戏服。

entries.en: Agnelli found a quiet corner where we could discuss the surprise party.
entries.zh: 阿涅利找了个安静的角落，好让我们讨论惊喜派对的安排。

entries.en: Agnelo balanced the breakfast tray carefully as he crossed the crowded room.
entries.zh: 阿格内洛穿过拥挤的房间时，小心地端稳早餐托盘。

entries.en: Agnese moved her desk so the afternoon sun would not hit the screen.
entries.zh: 阿格内塞移动了书桌，免得午后的阳光照到屏幕上。

entries.en: Agneta stopped sewing when the kitchen timer rang.
entries.zh: 厨房定时器响起时，阿格妮塔停下了缝纫。

entries.meaningZh: 意大利肉饺〔意大利借词，单复同形〕
entries.en: The waiter brought our meat-filled agnolotti before the rest of the meal.
entries.zh: 服务员先送来了我们的意大利肉饺，之后才上其余的菜。

entries.en: The archaeologists compared the layouts of two agorae uncovered during separate excavations.
entries.zh: 考古学家比较了两处分别在不同发掘中出土的古希腊集市的布局。

entries.en: Agosin returned the library books before joining us at the cafe.
entries.zh: 阿戈辛归还图书馆的书后，才到咖啡馆与我们会合。

entries.en: Agostinho caught the runaway shopping trolley before it reached the road.
entries.zh: 阿戈什蒂纽在购物推车滑到马路前抓住了它。

entries.en: Agostini recognised the melody but could not remember the singer's name.
entries.zh: 阿戈斯蒂尼认出了旋律，却想不起歌手的名字。

entries.en: The costume's agrafe came loose just before the actor went onstage.
entries.zh: 演员即将上台时，戏服上的金属钩钮松脱了。

entries.en: Agresti held the lift door open for a neighbour carrying groceries.
entries.zh: 阿格雷斯蒂替一位提着食品杂货的邻居扶住了电梯门。

entries.en: The family sold its agri-business rather than divide it among the heirs.
entries.zh: 这家人没有把农业综合企业分给各位继承人，而是将它卖掉了。

entries.en: The agribusinessman postponed the warehouse expansion after the harvest failed.
entries.zh: 收成不好之后，那位农业综合经营者推迟了仓库扩建计划。

entries.en: The supplier withdrew an agrichemical from the order after discovering a damaged container.
entries.zh: 供应商发现一个容器受损后，从订单中撤下了一种农用化学品。

entries.en: The cooperative kept separate purchase records for seeds and agrichemicals.
entries.zh: 合作社分别保留了种子和农业化学药品的采购记录。

entries.en: The old agrimotor sank into the mud beside the gate.
entries.zh: 那台旧农用拖拉机在大门旁陷进了泥里。

entries.en: Agrippina left the window open to let the smell of paint escape.
entries.zh: 阿格里皮娜开着窗，好让油漆味散出去。

entries.en: The school moved its agriscience classes into a converted greenhouse.
entries.zh: 学校把农业科学课搬到了一间改造过的温室里上。

entries.en: The village's plans for agritourism included guided orchard walks rather than a large hotel.
entries.zh: 这个村的农家乐旅游业规划包括果园导览步行活动，而不是建一座大酒店。

entries.en: The agrobiologist joined the farmers in examining roots from the damaged field.
entries.zh: 那位农业生物学家与农民们一起检查了受损田地里的植株根部。

entries.en: The cooperative bought a small agrobusiness that packed fruit for local growers.
entries.zh: 合作社收购了一家为当地种植户包装水果的小型农业综合企业。

entries.en: A disagreement about soil analysis drew her into agrochemistry during her final undergraduate year.
entries.zh: 本科最后一年，一场关于土壤分析的争论促使她涉足农业化学领域。

entries.en: His training in agroclimatology helped him frame questions about the farm's changing rainfall patterns.
entries.zh: 农业气候学训练帮助他就农场降雨模式的变化提出了问题。

entries.en: Students of agroecology spent the morning comparing the farm's hedgerows and open fields.
entries.zh: 学习农业生态学的学生花了一上午，比较农场的树篱与开阔田地。

entries.en: The proposed road would divide the agroecosystem the team had been monitoring.
entries.zh: 拟建的道路将把研究小组一直监测的农业生态系统分隔开。

entries.en: The agroforester walked the boundary with us before discussing where trees might be planted.
entries.zh: 那位农业林业学者先和我们沿着地界走了一遍，然后才讨论可以在哪里种树。

entries.en: She borrowed a geological map to prepare for the agrogeology field trip.
entries.zh: 她借了一张地质图，为农业地质学野外考察做准备。

entries.en: Our workshop in agrohydrology began with a walk along the farm's drainage channels.
entries.zh: 我们的农业水文学研习班从沿农场排水沟步行考察开始。

entries.en: The agrologist asked permission to examine the soil beneath the abandoned orchard.
entries.zh: 那位农业土壤学家请求获准检查废弃果园下面的土壤。
